title: Niagara Falls Day Tour from Toronto with Boat Cruise and Lunch
includes: Boat Cruise (if boat is not operating, it will be substituted by Journey Behind the Falls)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult

All infants and toddlers traveling on our vehicles are required to occupy their own seat. For safety purposes, they must be secured in a government-approved car seat or booster seat appropriate for their age, height, and weight.
The boat cruise is usually available from May to October, but exact dates are weather dependent and out of our control.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the world-famous Niagara Falls on a full-day tour from Toronto. Travel in a late-model, climate-controlled coach through the Niagara Peninsula, arriving early so you’re among the first to board the iconic Hornblower Niagara Cruises boat (ticket included) for an unforgettable trip to the base of the Falls.

After the cruise, enjoy approximately two hours of free time to explore the area and nearby attractions. Then, sit down to an included lunch overlooking the Falls, soaking in spectacular views while you dine.

Following lunch, continue along the scenic Niagara Parkway to view the powerful Niagara Whirlpool. In the summer this tour will visit the charming town of Niagara-on-the-Lake and stop at Maple Leaf Place for a maple syrup tasting experience before returning to Toronto, in time for evening plans.
